name: Ω Governed Content Task Pipeline

bucket_enforcement.purpose: Server-side size ceiling matching the existing upload.js client cap; MIME allowlist remains open for arbitrary binary attachments.

validation.note: content-ingest downloads the private object, enforces the 50 MiB limit, identifies common byte signatures and records SHA-256. The provider was observed active at version 13 on 2026-11-20. Exact version-13 source parity has not yet been independently re-captured. Signature identification is not malware scanning or rights clearance; no production Storage object currently exists to exercise a member upload transaction.

release_rule: Provider deployment evidence is recorded, but authenticated end-to-end transaction evidence, rights/publication/entitlement and malware-scan evidence remain separate truth gates.

content-ingest.note: Read-only production verification on 2026-11-20 observed ACTIVE provider version 13 with byte-signature MIME detection and SHA-256 validation. The older 2026-11-17 live inventory captured version 11; exact version-13 source parity has not yet been independently re-captured. Malware scan remains UNAVAILABLE; rights and publication remain UNVERIFIED.

provider_evidence.limitation: content-ingest was observed at provider version 13 on 2026-11-20; the earlier byte-for-byte inventory still records version 11, so exact version-13 source parity must be re-captured. content-delivery remains provider version 11 with entrypoint parity recorded in the 2026-11-17 inventory. Production currently has zero Storage objects and zero storage_files rows, so no production member upload/download transaction has been observed. Malware scanning, rights review, publication approval and entitlements remain separate fail-closed gates.

publication_attachment_reference.legacy_behavior: Raw user-id-prefixed Storage paths remain readable through the legacy owner-scoped signed URL path.
publication_attachment_reference.new_upload_behavior: New uploads must complete content-ingest before the typed reference is committed.
